text:
maria_cto: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment. Please drop clarifying Qs and volunteers for actions here.

anna_security: Summary: SOC2 initial scope = hosted API + Console (target end of Q2). Dedicated and Private control plane to be scoped later. I'll post a detailed scope doc.

devon_infra: Private control plane pilot for 2 customers next week. Need an onboarding checklist and an "installer" runbook.

sam_product: Customers asking for BYOK + HSM. What's our immediate plan?

anna_security: Roadmap: Q3 = BYOK via customer-managed cloud KMS (KEK support). Q4 = HSM integrations (partner-backed). We'll produce a key-rotation playbook.

ops-lead: Audit logs: default retention = 90 days. Enterprise tiers: 1yr and 7yr. We redact raw prompt text by default; customers can contract for different options.

jules_engineer: Infra note: 90d key rotation could break long-lived KV caches. Recommend key-versioning or 180d rotation.

anna_security: Good catch. We'll sync and pick a compromise + compatibility plan.

ops-lead: I'll own alerts/runbook for decrypt failures and share by EOD Tue.

security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 gap review Thu 10:00am (zoom.link) :bell:

maria_cto: Action items: anna -> SOC2 scope doc; devon -> pilot onboarding checklist; ops-lead -> retention tiers + decrypt runbook; sam -> collect HSM customer asks. Due: next Wed EOD. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
